name: Revenue disclosure — circumstances of postponement
definition: In addition to the disclosures required by AS 1 on Disclosure of Accounting Policies, an enterprise should disclose the circumstances in which revenue recognition has been postponed pending the resolution of significant uncertainties.
why_it_exists: Postponement is invisible in the numbers. A period where revenue was postponed and a period where none was earned look identical on the face of the statement of profit and loss. The disclosure is the only place the reader learns that revenue exists but is being withheld, and why.
inputs: the set of transactions where recognition was postponed in the period
the significant uncertainty that caused each postponement
the accounting policy disclosures already required by AS 1
outputs: a disclosure of the circumstances of postponement
or a positive finding that no revenue recognition was postponed in the period
preconditions: financial statements are being prepared for a period
recognition of some revenue was postponed pending resolution of significant uncertainties
exceptions: UNKNOWN — AS 9 paragraph 14 states no exception to this disclosure. Whether materiality qualifies it is not decided in the operative text; the Preface reference in the standard's footnote 1 was not extracted or verified in this pass.
common_mistakes: postponing recognition correctly and then disclosing nothing, which hides the postponement entirely
treating the AS-1 accounting policy disclosure as sufficient — AS 9 para 14 requires this disclosure IN ADDITION to it
disclosing the amount alone without the circumstances; the standard requires the circumstances
legal_references: UNKNOWN — statutory backing not extracted from any downloaded source in this pass
icai_references: AS 9, paragraph 14; and AS 1 on Disclosure of Accounting Policies, as cross-referenced by AS 9 para 14
gst_references: NOT APPLICABLE — this is a financial statement disclosure, unrelated to any GST return or filing
evidence_required: the list of postponed items with the uncertainty attached to each
the AS-1 accounting policy note, to confirm this disclosure is additional to it and not folded into it
confidence_factors: weak when postponement decisions were made per-transaction and never aggregated, so the population is not knowable at period end
weak when the reason for a postponement was not recorded at the time it was made
validation_checks: every postponement recorded in the period appears in the disclosure
the disclosure states the CIRCUMSTANCES, not only an amount
the disclosure is additional to, and does not replace, the AS-1 accounting policy disclosures
examples: a price escalation claim raised in the period whose collection could not be assessed with reasonable certainty — recognition postponed, and the circumstances disclosed
royalties from a foreign licensee awaiting exchange permission with remittance uncertainty anticipated — recognition postponed, and the circumstances disclosed
counterexamples: a doubt about collectability that arose AFTER the sale — that is handled by a separate provision under AS 9 para 9.3, not by postponement, so it is not what para 14 requires to be disclosed
a transaction outside the scope of AS 9 — para 14 attaches to postponement under this standard
